orig.tl: When we speak Chinese, since it is our national language, our common language, we should be able to understand each other, but [some people in Tshobdun] do not understand it completely either.' (150901 tshuBdWnskAt)

clean.tx: tɕiʑo andʑɯβritɕi ra

clean.tl: I am disappointed by you.' (elicited)

clean.tl: There was a bit of snow, but it is not serious, it can still melt.' (conversation 15-12-17)

clean.tx: kʰri ɯtaʁ nɯtɕu kombɣaʁ nɤ ɲɤmbɣaʁ tɕe
clean.tl: She tossed over her bed.' (140430 yufu he tade qizi-zh) <a href="https://doi.org/10.24397/pangloss-0003900#S226"></fn>

clean.tx: nɯ χsɯɣjɤn nɯnɤmbɣaʁlaʁ ɲɯŋu.
clean.tl: [The horse Rtamchog Rinpoche] rolled over on its back three times (on the beach).' (2005 Norbzang)

clean.tx: ɯχti ci nanɯɕar ri, tɕendɤre kɯmaqʰu qʰe pɯnɯɴɢɤtndʑi

clean.tx: ɯfsomɯr qʰendɤre, tɯlɤt nɯ ɯtaʁ kondzoʁ qʰe … tɯrmɯkʰa tɕe tɯlɤt nɯ ɯtaʁ koɴqoʁ tɕe,
clean.tl: The next day in the evening, he clung onto the second sister. (…) At dusk, he grabbed the second sister.' (07-deluge) <a href="https://doi.org/10.24397/pangloss-0003426#S44"></fn> <a href="https://doi.org/10.24397/pangloss-0003426#S46"></fn>

clean.tx: ɣɯjpa ɯmɯntoʁ nɯkɤlɤt nɯ pɯnnɯŋgra kɯnɤ fsaqʰe qʰe nɯ ɯsta nɯ li nɯ jamar tɕʰi kɯtu nɯ ɯmat ɲɯβze ɕti
clean.tl: Even if the flowers that have blossomed this year and fall down, the next year it makes at that place as many fruits (as there were flowers the previous year).' (11-qarGW)

clean.tx: nɯrom kɯnɤ mɤɣɤɴɢlɯt
clean.tl: Even after it has dried up, [the wood of high mountain willow twig] does not break easily.' (07-Zmbri) <a href="https://doi.org/10.24397/pangloss-0003438#S52"></fn>

clean.tx: zrɯɣ nɯnɤmbɣaʁlaʁ rdɯl mɤtɕɤt
clean.tl: When a louse rolls around, it does not raise dust.' (proverb)

clean.tx: nɯnɯ rgoŋlu nɯ nɯɕimɯma ʑo tɯnɤndʐaβlaβ joʑa tɕe jondʐaβ nɤ jondʐaβ.
clean.tl: The ball immediately started rolling over and over.' (140514 huishuohua de niao-zh)

clean.tx: tɕe nɯnɯ pjɯ́wɣta tɕe, tɕe snama tɤŋke tɕe tɕe, mɤnɤŋgiolo.
clean.tl: One puts [belly and neck bands on the burdens], so that when the beast of burden walks, [the burden] does not move around [on its back].' (30-tAsno)

clean.tx: tɤpɤtso tɤjpɣom ɯtaʁ ɲɯnɯŋgiolɯlo
clean.tl: The child slides on the ice.' (elicited)

clean.tx: tamar cʰɤsɯɣndʐita

clean.tx: kʰru nɯ cʰɯftʂinɯ tɕe, tɕe nɯnɯ pjɯlɤtnɯ ɲɯɕti tɕe,
clean.tl: They melt the pig iron and pour it into [the mold].' (25-qraR)

clean.tx: ɯjme nɯ … ki tufse tuznɯndzi tɕe tɕe ɲɯqɤt ɲɯŋu.

clean.tx: aʑɯɣ ame ci tu tɕe, nɯnɯ kɯ tɯsŋaʁ paβzjoz tɕe,

clean.tx: ɯme nɯ pɯrɤβzjoz ri tʰam ɯ<gongzuo> ɯma me

clean.tx: sqɯmpɕar kɤŋata
clean.tl: I bought [it] on credit and owe [him] ten renminbi.' (elicited)

clean.tx: tɕe nɯnɯ ɯrme tu ma mɤsɤndza ma ɯmdzu me.
clean.tl: It has hair, but does not prick, because it has no thorns.' (15-babW)

clean.tx: akumpɣa ɯpɯ kɯsɤjndɯjndɤt ʑo pɯŋu ri, tɕeri <xingqitian> <fangjia> tɕe tunɯɕea pɯra tɕe ɕkɤrɤɕtʂɯa.

clean.tl: He came and asked me (for information).' (elicited)

clean.tx: χsɯsla pɯβzjoza
clean.tl: I have learned [how to make ploughshares] for three months.' (2010-09)

clean.tx: nɯra nɯpʰe nɯtɕu, χsɯxpa nɯ pɯrɤβzjoza.

clean.tx: tɕe nɯnɯ julɤtnɯ tɕe tɕe nɯnɯ wuma ʑo ɲɯsɤsat … qro ri ɲɯxtɕi ɕti, tɕe nɯnɯ kɯ rcanɯ tɯkʰɤl tɕe ʁnɯz χsɯm jamar pjɯsat ɲɯŋu
clean.tl: They shoot with [scattering bullets], and it is very lethal, (…) the pigeons are small, [with scattering bullets] they kill two or three [pigeons] in one place.' (28-CAmWGdW) <a href="https://doi.org/10.24397/pangloss-0003712#S110"></fn>, <a href="https://doi.org/10.24397/pangloss-0003712#S115"></fn>

clean.tx: rɯdaʁ nɯ ɯŋgɯ kɯsɤndza nɯ, kɯrŋi tukɯti ŋu
clean.tl: Among the animals, the carnivorous ones are called `beasts'.' (elicited, explanation of example ex:kWsAndza.GW, §sec:subject.participle.subject.relative)

clean.tx: aʑo kɯsɤtʰu ɕea
clean.tl: I am going to ask for (the girls) in marriage.' (2003 Kunbzang)

clean.tx: tɯmɯ wuma ʑo tɤme tɕe, tɕendɤre tsʰitsuku ɕkusɤnɯrtɕanɯ tɕe, fsaŋ ra ɕpjɯtanɯ, ɕpjɯrɟaʁnɯ nɯra tɕe, tɕe tɯmɯ kusɯlɤtnɯ pjɤŋgrɤl. tɕe nɯ ɯsɤznɤma ɣɯ sɤtɕʰa nɯ znɤrɣɤma tutinɯ ɲɯŋu
clean.tl: When there was no rain at all, people would go there and do teasing, make fumigations and dance, and cause rain to come. They call the place where these activities were performed znɤrɣɤma.' (140522 Kamnyu zgo) <a href="https://doi.org/10.24397/pangloss-0004059#S237"></fn>

clean.tx: ʑɯβdaʁ ɕkúwɣnɯrtɕa

clean.tl: I was on the terrace eating meat, and suddenly a falcon came down without me noticing, and took away the [piece of] meat in my hand.' (150909 qandZGi) <a href="https://doi.org/10.24397/pangloss-0006358#S4"></fn>

clean.tx: tɕendɤre ʁnɯkuxtɕo tosɯmtsʰɤt tɕe

clean.tl: When the old man came down from the tree, he realized that [the pears] had been taken away, but could not do anything about it.' (chen-pear)

clean.tx: taʁi nɯ kɯ nɯŋa ɯndʐi nɯnɯ cʰɤrɤɣdɯt qʰendɤre cʰɤtʂɯβ. tɕendɤre nɤki, tamar tɯtɯɣɟaβ nɯ tondo qʰe, ɯŋgɯ nɯtɕu koʑɣɤmpʰɯr.
clean.tl: The younger brother skinned the hide of the cow and sewed it. He took one churnfull of butter, and wrapped himself inside [the hide].' (07-deluge)

clean.tx: tɯci mɯtosɯɤlata
clean.tl: I did not put the water to boil.' (Conversation, 01-05-2018, Tshendzin)

clean.tx: tɯrme ɣɯ ɯʁjoʁ ɲɤkɤβzuaci

clean.tx: tɯci kɤtata ri, <dian> mɯtozwara

clean.tx: mtsʰalu koɣɤndʑama ɲɯmaʁ
clean.tl: It is not the nettles that I warmed.' (Conversation, 07-05-2018, Tshendzin)

clean.tx: ɲɤnɯjmɯta
clean.tl: I forgot.' (many attestations)

clean.tx: nɤʑo kɯfse aŋkʰor nɯ mɯpjɤmtota

clean.tx: mɤʑɯ ʑo tompɕɤr

clean.tx: mɯrmɯmbju ɯpɯ nɯnɯ … ɯtɯɣmaz ra tomna tɕe, ɲɯnɯqambɯmbjom tocʰa.
clean.tl: The swallow's wounds healed, and it was able to fly [again].' (150825 huluwa-zh)

clean.tx: ɲimawozɤr nɯ kɯ, [srɯnmɯ nɯ pjɤftɯl], … [rŋgɯ kɤkɯnɤχtɕɤn ra pjɤftɯl], tɕe iɕqʰa srɯnmɯ nɯ ɣɯ ɯkɯra nɯra [smɤnmimitoʁkuɕana ri ɕkonɤʁdɤn] pjɤcʰa

clean.tx: [zdɯm kɯɲaʁ nɯ cʰɤsɯjɣɤt] pjɤcʰa ɲɯŋu.

clean.tx: pɯnɤpeta

clean.tl: The old woman was sewing nets (like before).' (140430 yufu he tade qizi-zh)

clean.tx: ajaʁ ri li kɯkɯra ntsɯ pɯtu tɕe pɯdɤn. tɕeri nɯ ɯqʰu li iɕqʰa stu kɯmɤku nɯkɯɬoʁ nɯnɯme qʰe tɕe ɲɤnɯme
clean.tl: I had [warts] on my hand there, and there were a lot. But later, the [wart] that had first come out disappeared by itself, and [the rest] disappeared.' (24-pGArtsAG)

clean.tl: Yesterday you called [me] many times (on the phone), but I did not hear it, as I was cooking.' (conversation, 14-12-2018)

clean.tx: tɕʰeme nɯnɯkʰɤdata ri, mɯ́jpʰɤn, tɕe pɯnɯɣɤwu ɕti
clean.tl: I comforted the girl, but to no avail, [as] she was still crying.' (2003 zrAntCW tWrme)

clean.tx: praʁkʰaŋ ci pjɤtu qʰe, praʁkʰaŋ ɯŋgɯ nɯtɕu pjɤfsoʁ. nɯ ɯrkɯ nɯra rcanɯ, li nɤkinɯ, si ra pjɤkɤrŋici ʑo. nɤkinɯ, mɯntoʁ kɯnɤ wuma ʑo pjɤdɤn, tɕe pjɤsɤscit. … ɯŋgɯ loɕe ri, tɕe nɯnɯtɕu rgɤtpu χsɯm kɯ, nɤki, kumbrɤl pjɤkɤsɯlɤtnɯ
clean.tl: There was a cave. Inside the cave, there was light. Around it, the trees were green, and there were many flowers, it was a very nice [place]. (…) He entered [the cave], and in there there were three old men playing chess.' (150902 qixian-zh)

clean.tx: wuma ʑo pɯasɯndzandʑi, pɯpe jamar ʑo tɕe tɕendɤre, nɯnɯ, nɤki, kʰa nɯ ɣɯ ɯkɯm toɲɟɯ
clean.tl: While/Right at the moment when they were eating [the sweets] in big quantity and were [enjoying it], the door of the house opened.' (140507 tangguowu-zh)

clean.tl: It would have been better if [the name] mɯɣʑɯsapa had been written down there (on a sheet of paper where many names of locations in the mountains had been written).' (140522 Kamnyu zgo) <a href="https://doi.org/10.24397/pangloss-0004059#S80"></fn>

clean.tx: nɤkʰa jɤɣea ri, aku kɤnɯrputa

clean.tl: When I came to your house, if I had lowered my head, I wouldn't have bumped it [into the door frame].' (elicited)

clean.tx: tɕʰeme ci pɯtaʁ ɲɯŋu
clean.tl: A girl was weaving.' (2003 tWxtsa)

clean.tx: “ɕɯ kɯ nɯtɯ́wɣmbi tɤti ma mɤjɤɣ" kʰɯtinɯ.

clean.tx: “nɤkɤχcɤl nɤʁrɯ nɯ pjɯtɯpʰɯt tɕe kɤnɯɕe ɲɯkʰɯ kʰi" ti ɲɯŋu

clean.tl: In the forest, there was a wolf, and he was looking for food everywhere.' (140428 xiaohongmao-zh)

clean.tx: ɲɯtɯɤ́<wɣ>znɯkʰramba
clean.tl: S/he is cheating you.' (elicited)

clean.tl: His_i companion is waiting for him_i.' (elicited)

clean.tx: nɯnɯ qaprɤŋar kɯ zdɯm tutɕɤt ŋu tɕe tɯmɯ lɤt tutinɯ ŋgrɤl

clean.tl: It is this colour.' (23-mbrAZim) <a href="https://doi.org/10.24397/pangloss-0003604#S6"></fn>

clean.tl: Before that I had other medicine, [another] calcium tablet like that, and that was the one I was taking. I [started] taking the [medicine] you sent me when [the previous one] was finished up. The [medicine] you sent me, the calcium tablet, I am taking that (now).' (conversation 17-08-21)

clean.tx: tɕe [tɤpɤtso ra kɯ aznɯrdoʁnɯ ɯraŋ] ʑo tɕe tɕendɤre, ʑɤni daltsɯtsa ɲɤʑɣɤsɯɤrqʰindʑi tɕe
clean.tl: While the children were collecting [firewood](piece by piece), [their parents] slowly moved away (from them).' (160630 poucet1)

clean.tx: jɯatara ʑo ɲɯŋu

clean.tl: This is [made of] glass, if you put it like that in something else, I am afraid it will break.' (elicited)

clean.tx: ɕɯtɯtɯt kɯ

clean.tx: ɕɯa<nɯ>ri kɯ

clean.tl: I fear that you will not win the contest, this is what I am worried about.' (2003 sras)

clean.tl: Afraid of being late (thinking `I am afraid that I will be late'), they came from the four corners of the world.' (150906 toutao)

clean.tx: mɯɕɯkʰɯ kɯ nɯsɯsota
clean.tl: I thought it would not work.' (conversation, 02-05-2018; after opening a washing machine, expecting it would not open)

clean.tx: ɕɯkɯmpɕaa kɯ!
clean.tl: I am afraid that you will scold me.' (elicited)

clean.tl: I don't know whether I will be able to do it, I am still young.' (2010-09)

clean.tx: ɯmɤjɤazɣɯt
clean.tl: He probably has already arrived.' (elicited)

clean.tl: Maybe birds eat it.' (17-thowum) <a href="https://doi.org/10.24397/pangloss-0003526#S39"></fn>

clean.tx: ɯmɤcʰɯmɤɕia
clean.tl: If only I could become rich!' (elicited)

clean.tl: She was thinking all the time: `If only I could see the prince!” (150819 haidenver-zh)
